_doc: Needs at the hangouts (Needs, scripts/systems/needs.gd). A layout lists its hangouts: spots where people want something ({id, name, at, x, z, r, needs, who?}). A need is met while a piece that provides it ("provides" in pieces.json) stands inside the hangout and someone can walk up to it (or, for shelter, stand under it). Each met need adds `points` to the approval rating; charm adds up to charm.max more per hangout, for the variety of pieces and colours there, less for repeats (charm.repeat: what the first, second, ... piece of a kind is worth). Each morning up to `open_max` needs are noticed (only for pieces you can already build) and the paper says so. {place} is a hangout's `at`, {Place} the same with a capital.

shelter.name: shelter from the rain
shelter.noticed: Nowhere to keep dry {place} when it rains.

green.name: something green
green.noticed: Not a flower {place}. People have noticed.

stall.name: a counter to sell from
stall.noticed: Nowhere to set out a stall {place}.
